idebenone protected retinal ganglion neurons against complex I dysfunction and loss of vision in a mouse model for the inherited eye disease, Leber’s Hereditory Optic Neuropath.

idebenone protects retinal ganglion and retinal function in a mouse model for Leber’s heredity optic neuropathy (mitochondrial complex I dysfunction) and that this protective activity is associated with the penetration of idebenone into the eye at pharmacologically active concentrations.
